in_sanskrit.name: कृष्णदास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is a servant or slave to Lord Krishna

in_marathi.name: Krishnadasa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnadasa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishnadasa is a combination of two words: Krishna and dasa. Krishna means 'God' and dasa means 'servant'. Thus, Krishnadasa can be interpreted as 'God's servant' or 'devotee of Krishna'.

in_bengali.name: Krishnadasa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's servant
in_bengali.long_meaning: Krishnadasa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Krishnadasa is a combination of two words: Krishna and dasa. Krishna means 'God' and dasa means 'servant'. Thus, Krishnadasa can be interpreted as 'God's servant' or 'devotee of Krishna'.
